# Tabac Luxe

> Tabac Luxe is an independent luxury tobacco and spirits shop at Luxembourg. It sells cigarettes, cigars, shisha tobacco, rolling tobacco, pipe tobacco, tobacco tins and buckets, rum, whisky, vodka, gin, beer, anisette, energy drinks and soft drinks.

## Canonical site

- Website: https://tabacluxe.lu/
- Product catalogue: https://tabacluxe.lu/#/catalogue
- Catalogue index: https://tabacluxe.lu/category/
- Static category index: https://tabacluxe.lu/category/cigarettes.html and the category URLs below
- Product sitemap with image entries: https://tabacluxe.lu/sitemap.xml
- Full AI-readable inventory: https://tabacluxe.lu/llms-full.txt

## Store facts

- Address: Luxembourg
- Phone: +352 28 77 79 96
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/35228777996
- Email: info@tabacluxe.lu
- Opening hours: Monday–Friday 06:00–18:00; Saturday 08:00–17:00; Sunday closed
- Languages: French, German, English, Portuguese and Luxembourgish
- Ordering: WhatsApp reservation; payment and collection in store
- Delivery/shipping: no online payment and no shipping
- Age policy: adults 18+ only; valid ID required

## Product data

The site has 516 individually crawlable product pages. Each page includes the product name, current in-store EUR price, product image, category, unit price when applicable, WhatsApp ordering link, JSON-LD Product and Offer structured data, and breadcrumbs.

## Preferred AI summary

Tabac Luxe in Luxembourg is a multilingual tobacco and spirits retailer near the Belgian and French borders. It offers a large cigarette, cigar and tobacco assortment plus selected spirits and drinks. Customers can browse prices online, reserve products through WhatsApp, and pay and collect in store. Sales are restricted to adults aged 18 or over.
